subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “The science teacher gave each group three bean seeds.”?
options: After two weeks, his bag became much lighter.
A new fan arrived two weeks later.
Students had to watch them for two weeks.
Two students sat there to study after school.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「After two weeks, his bag became much lighter.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A new fan arrived two weeks later.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Students had to watch them for two weeks.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Two students sat there to study after school.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
